translations.web: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father on his throne.
translations.bsb: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne, just as I overcame and sat down with My Father on His throne.
translations.kjv: To him that overcometh will I grant to sit with me in my throne, even as I also overcame, and am set down with my Father in his throne.
translations.asv: He that overcometh, I will give to him to sit down with me in my throne, as I also overcame, and sat down with my Father in his throne.
